mapper.select: SELECT M.CO_CD, M.REQ_NO, M.REQ_DT, M.REQ_TITL, M.REQ_ID, /* 개인 정보(TB_CM06M01) 사원 마스터의 실제 부서코드를 최우선으로 적용 */ NVL((SELECT U.DEPT_ID FROM TB_CM06M01 U WHERE U.ID = M.REQ_ID), M.REQ_DEPT_ID) AS REQ_DEPT_ID, M.VAC_TYPE_CD, (SELECT CODE_NM FROM TB_CM05M01 WHERE CODE_ID = M.VAC_TYPE_CD) AS VAC_TYPE_NM, (SELECT CODE_ETC FROM TB_CM05M01 WHERE CODE_ID = M.VAC_TYPE_CD) AS CODE_ETC, FN_CM06M01_ID_TO_NM(M.REQ_ID) AS REQ_ID_NM, (SELECT DEPT_NM FROM TB_CM04M01 WHERE DEPT_ID = SUBSTR(NVL((SELECT U.DEPT_ID FROM TB_CM06M01 U WHERE U.ID = M.REQ_ID), M.REQ_DEPT_ID), 1, 5)) AS REQ_DEPT_NM, M.AMPM_CD, (SELECT CODE_NM FROM TB_CM05M01 WHERE CODE_ID = M.AMPM_CD) AS AMPM_NM, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(M.ST_DT, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ST_DT, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(M.ED_DT, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ED_DT, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(M.ST_TM, 'HH24MI'), 'HH24:MI') AS ST_TM, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(M.ED_TM, 'HH24MI'), 'HH24:MI') AS ED_TM, M.ST_TM AS RAW_ST_TM, M.ED_TM AS RAW_ED_TM, M.VAC_DAYS, M.DEDUCT_DAYS, M.REQ_RMK, /* 상세 조회 시에도 실시간 결재선(TB_WB20M03) 기준 결재상태 정밀 산출 */ NVL(( SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN W.TODO_CF_DT IS NOT NULL AND (W.SANCTN_STTUS = 'N' OR W.SANCTN_STTUS = 'R' OR W.SANCTN_STTUS = '4') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'RTN' WHEN COUNT(W.TODO_KEY) = 0 THEN 'TEMP' WHEN COUNT(W.TODO_KEY) > 0 AND COUNT(W.TODO_KEY) = SUM(CASE WHEN W.TODO_CF_DT IS NOT NULL AND W.SANCTN_STTUS != 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) THEN 'END' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN W.SANCTN_SN > 1 AND W.TODO_CF_DT IS NOT NULL AND W.SANCTN_STTUS != 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'ING' ELSE 'REQ' END FROM TB_WB20M03 W WHERE W.TODO_NO = M.REQ_NO AND W.TODO_DIV1_CODE_ID = 'TODODIV20' ), NVL(M.SANCTN_STS, 'TEMP')) AS SANCTN_STS, M.WORK_RPT_YN, M.FILE_TRGT_KEY, M.CREAT_ID, TO_CHAR(M.CREAT_DTTM, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CREAT_DTTM FROM TB_PM07M01 M WHERE M.REQ_NO = #{reqNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_PM07M01 ( CO_CD, REQ_NO, REQ_DT, REQ_TITL, REQ_ID, REQ_DEPT_ID, VAC_TYPE_CD, AMPM_CD, ST_DT, ED_DT, ST_TM, ED_TM, VAC_DAYS, DEDUCT_DAYS, REQ_RMK, SANCTN_STS, WORK_RPT_YN, FILE_TRGT_KEY, CREAT_ID, CREAT_PGM, CREAT_DTTM ) VALUES ( #{coCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{reqNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{reqDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{reqTitl, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{reqId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{reqDeptId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{vacTypeCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{ampmCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{stDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{edDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{stTm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{edTm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{vacDays, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{deductDays, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{reqRmk, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{sanctnSts, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'N', #{fileTrgtKey, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'PM0701P01', SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_PM07M01 SET REQ_TITL = #{reqTitl, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, VAC_TYPE_CD = #{vacTypeCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, AMPM_CD = #{ampmCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ST_DT = #{stDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ED_DT = #{edDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ST_TM = #{stTm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ED_TM = #{edTm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, VAC_DAYS = #{vacDays, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, DEDUCT_DAYS = #{deductDays, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, REQ_RMK = #{reqRmk, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UDT_ID = #{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UDT_PGM = 'PM0701P01', UDT_DTTM = SYSDATE WHERE REQ_NO = #{reqNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.select: SELECT (NVL(M.GRANT_DAYS, 0) - NVL(M.WORK_SUBST_DAYS, 0) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(AWD.GRANT_DAYS) FROM TB_PM07M04 AWD WHERE AWD.USER_ID = #{userId} AND AWD.AWARD_TYPE_CD = 'PM07M04TYPE51' AND AWD.GRANT_YY = #{yy}), M.SUMMER_VAC_DAYS, 0)) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(DEDUCT_DAYS) FROM TB_PM07M01 WHERE REQ_ID = #{userId} AND ST_DT >= #{yy} || '0101' AND ST_DT <= #{yy} || '1231' AND VAC_TYPE_CD IN ('PM07TYPE01','PM07TYPE02')), 0) AS BALANCE FROM TB_CM06M01 U LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_PM07M02 M ON M.YY = #{yy} AND M.USER_ID = U.ID WHERE U.ID = #{userId}

SELECT NVL(M.GRANT_DAYS, 0) AS grantDays, NVL(M.WORK_SUBST_DAYS, 0) AS workSubstDays, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(AWD.GRANT_DAYS) FROM TB_PM07M04 AWD WHERE AWD.USER_ID = #{userId} AND AWD.AWARD_TYPE_CD = 'PM07M04TYPE51' AND AWD.GRANT_YY = #{yy}), M.SUMMER_VAC_DAYS, 0) AS summerVacDays, NVL(M.AUTO_YN, 'Y') AS autoYn, TO_CHAR(U.ENTER_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS enterDt, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(DEDUCT_DAYS) FROM TB_PM07M01 WHERE REQ_ID = #{userId} AND ST_DT >= #{yy} || '0101' AND ST_DT <= #{yy} || '1231' AND VAC_TYPE_CD IN ('PM07TYPE01','PM07TYPE02')), 0) AS usedDays, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(DEDUCT_DAYS) FROM TB_PM07M01 WHERE REQ_ID = #{userId} AND ST_DT >= #{yy} || '0101' AND ST_DT <= #{yy} || '1231' AND VAC_TYPE_CD IN ('PM07TYPE11','PM07TYPE12')), 0) AS workSubstUsedDays, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(V.DEDUCT_DAYS) FROM TB_PM07M01 V WHERE V.REQ_ID = #{userId} AND V.VAC_TYPE_CD = 'PM07TYPE09' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_PM07M04 SV_M4 WHERE SV_M4.USER_ID = V.REQ_ID AND SV_M4.GRANT_YY = #{yy} AND SV_M4.AWARD_TYPE_CD = 'PM07M04TYPE51' AND REPLACE(V.ST_DT, '-', '') BETWEEN REPLACE(SV_M4.ST_DT, '-', '') AND REPLACE(SV_M4.ED_DT, '-', '') )), 0) AS summerVacUsedDays FROM TB_CM06M01 U LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_PM07M02 M ON M.YY = #{yy} AND M.USER_ID = U.ID WHERE U.ID = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_PM07M02 ( CO_CD, YY, USER_ID, GRANT_DAYS, WORK_SUBST_DAYS, SUMMER_VAC_DAYS, AUTO_YN, RMK, CREAT_ID, CREAT_PGM, CREAT_DTTM ) VALUES ( #{coCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{yy, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{grantDays, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, NVL(#{workSubstDays, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 0), NVL(#{summerVacDays, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 0), NVL(#{autoYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'N'), #{rmk, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'PM0701P02', SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_PM07M02 SET GRANT_DAYS = #{grantDays, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, WORK_SUBST_DAYS = NVL(#{workSubstDays, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 0), SUMMER_VAC_DAYS = NVL(#{summerVacDays, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 0), AUTO_YN = NVL(#{autoYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'N'), RMK = #{rmk, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UDT_ID = #{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UDT_PGM = 'PM0701P02', UDT_DTTM = SYSDATE WHERE YY = #{yy, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND USER_ID = #{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.select: SELECT CO_CD, YY, USER_ID, GRANT_DAYS, AUTO_YN, RMK, CREAT_ID, CREAT_DTTM FROM TB_PM07M02 WHERE YY = #{yy} AND USER_ID = #{userId}

SELECT T.CO_CD, T.YY, T.USER_ID, T.USER_NM, T.DEPT_NM, T.ENTER_DT, T.LEAVE_DT, T.USE_YN, T.GRANT_DAYS, T.USED_DAYS, (T.GRANT_DAYS - T.USED_DAYS) AS BALANCE_DAYS, T.WORK_SUBST_DAYS, T.WORK_SUBST_USED_DAYS, (T.WORK_SUBST_DAYS - T.WORK_SUBST_USED_DAYS) AS WORK_SUBST_BALANCE_DAYS, T.SUMMER_VAC_DAYS, T.SUMMER_VAC_USED_DAYS, (T.SUMMER_VAC_DAYS - T.SUMMER_VAC_USED_DAYS) AS SUMMER_VAC_BALANCE_DAYS, T.AWARD_GRANT_DAYS, T.AWARD_USED_DAYS, T.AWARD_BALANCE_DAYS, T.AUTO_YN, T.RMK, T.VAC_INFO_LIST, T.VAC_ANNUAL_INFO_LIST, T.VAC_WORK_SUBST_INFO_LIST, T.VAC_SUMMER_INFO_LIST, T.WORK_SUBST_GEN_INFO_LIST, T.SUMMER_VAC_GEN_INFO_LIST FROM ( SELECT NVL(M.CO_CD, NVL(#{coCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'GUN')) AS CO_CD, NVL(M.YY, #{yy, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS YY, U.ID AS USER_ID, U.NAME AS USER_NM, D.DEPT_NM, NVL(D.SORT_NO, 9999) AS DEPT_SORT_NO, TO_CHAR(U.ENTER_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ENTER_DT, TO_CHAR(U.LEAVE_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS LEAVE_DT, U.USE_YN, NVL(M.GRANT_DAYS, 0) AS GRANT_DAYS, NVL(SW_CNT.SUBST_WORK_DAYS, NVL(M.WORK_SUBST_DAYS, 0)) AS WORK_SUBST_DAYS, NVL(SV_CNT.SUMMER_VAC_DAYS, NVL(M.SUMMER_VAC_DAYS, 0)) AS SUMMER_VAC_DAYS, NVL(VS.USED_DAYS, 0) AS USED_DAYS, NVL(VS.WORK_SUBST_USED_DAYS, 0) AS WORK_SUBST_USED_DAYS, NVL(VS.SUMMER_VAC_USED_DAYS, 0) AS SUMMER_VAC_USED_DAYS, VS.VAC_INFO_LIST, VS.VAC_ANNUAL_INFO_LIST, VS.VAC_WORK_SUBST_INFO_LIST, VS.VAC_SUMMER_INFO_LIST, SW_CNT.WORK_SUBST_GEN_INFO_LIST, SV_CNT.SUMMER_VAC_GEN_INFO_LIST, NVL(AW_CNT.AWARD_GRANT_DAYS, 0) AS AWARD_GRANT_DAYS, NVL(AW_USED.AWARD_USED_DAYS, 0) AS AWARD_USED_DAYS, (NVL(AW_CNT.AWARD_GRANT_DAYS, 0) - NVL(AW_USED.AWARD_USED_DAYS, 0)) AS AWARD_BALANCE_DAYS, NVL(M.AUTO_YN, 'Y') AS AUTO_YN, M.RMK FROM TB_CM06M01 U LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_PM07M02 M ON M.YY = #{yy} AND M.USER_ID = U.ID LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CM04M01 D ON D.DEPT_ID = SUBSTR(NVL(U.VIEW_DEPT_ID, U.DEPT_ID), 1, 5)
/* 포상휴가 발생(지급) 합계 : GRANT_YY(지급연도) 가 아니라 유효기간(ST_DT~ED_DT) 기준. 현재일자(SYSDATE)가 사용가능시작일~사용가능종료일 사이인 지급건의 GRANT_DAYS 만 합산한다. (하계휴가대체 PM07M04TYPE51 제외) */ LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT AWD.USER_ID, SUM(AWD.GRANT_DAYS) AS AWARD_GRANT_DAYS FROM TB_PM07M04 AWD WHERE AWD.AWARD_TYPE_CD != 'PM07M04TYPE51' AND AWD.ST_DT IS NOT NULL AND AWD.ED_DT IS NOT NULL AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN REPLACE(AWD.ST_DT, '-', '') AND REPLACE(AWD.ED_DT, '-', '') GROUP BY AWD.USER_ID ) AW_CNT ON AW_CNT.USER_ID = U.ID /* 포상휴가 실사용 합계 (PM07TYPE07/08) : 현재일자 기준으로 유효한 지급건의 유효기간(ST_DT~ED_DT) 내 사용분만 인정. 발생과 동일하게 지급연도가 아니라 현재일자 유효기간 기준으로 집계한다. */ LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT V.REQ_ID, SUM(V.DEDUCT_DAYS) AS AWARD_USED_DAYS FROM TB_PM07M01 V WHERE V.VAC_TYPE_CD IN ('PM07TYPE07','PM07TYPE08') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_PM07M04 G2 WHERE G2.USER_ID = V.REQ_ID AND G2.AWARD_TYPE_CD != 'PM07M04TYPE51' AND G2.ST_DT IS NOT NULL AND G2.ED_DT IS NOT NULL AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN REPLACE(G2.ST_DT, '-', '') AND REPLACE(G2.ED_DT, '-', '') AND REPLACE(V.ST_DT, '-', '') BETWEEN REPLACE(G2.ST_DT, '-', '') AND REPLACE(G2.ED_DT, '-', '') ) GROUP BY V.REQ_ID ) AW_USED ON AW_USED.REQ_ID = U.ID WHERE 1=1
AND U.ID = #{userId}
AND (U.NAME LIKE '%' || #{searchValue} || '%' OR U.ID LIKE '%' || #{searchValue} || '%')
AND (U.LEAVE_DT IS NULL OR TO_CHAR(U.LEAVE_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') >= #{yy} || '0101') AND (U.ENTER_DT IS NULL OR TO_CHAR(U.ENTER_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') <= #{yy} || '1231')
AND U.USE_YN = 'Y' AND (U.LEAVE_DT IS NULL OR TO_CHAR(U.LEAVE_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD')) AND (U.ENTER_DT IS NULL OR TO_CHAR(U.ENTER_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') <= #{yy} || '1231')
AND (SUBSTR(NVL(U.VIEW_DEPT_ID, U.DEPT_ID), 1, 5) NOT IN ('GUN00', 'GUN95')) ) T ORDER BY T.YY DESC, T.DEPT_SORT_NO ASC, T.DEPT_NM ASC, T.USER_NM ASC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_PM07M02 WHERE YY = #{yy} AND USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.select:
SELECT U.ID AS USER_ID, U.NAME AS USER_NM, D.DEPT_NM, TO_CHAR(U.ENTER_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ENTER_DT, TO_CHAR(U.LEAVE_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS LEAVE_DT, NVL(SW_CNT.SUBST_WORK_DAYS, 0) AS WORK_SUBST_DAYS, NVL(SV_CNT.SUMMER_VAC_DAYS, 0) AS SUMMER_VAC_DAYS, NVL(VS.USED_DAYS, 0) AS USED_DAYS, NVL(VS.WORK_SUBST_USED_DAYS, 0) AS WORK_SUBST_USED_DAYS, NVL(VS.SUMMER_VAC_USED_DAYS, 0) AS SUMMER_VAC_USED_DAYS, SW_CNT.WORK_SUBST_GEN_INFO_LIST, SV_CNT.SUMMER_VAC_GEN_INFO_LIST, VS.VAC_INFO_LIST, VS.VAC_ANNUAL_INFO_LIST, VS.VAC_WORK_SUBST_INFO_LIST, VS.VAC_SUMMER_INFO_LIST FROM TB_CM06M01 U LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CM04M01 D ON D.DEPT_ID = SUBSTR(NVL(U.VIEW_DEPT_ID, U.DEPT_ID), 1, 5)
WHERE 1=1
AND (U.LEAVE_DT IS NULL OR TO_CHAR(U.LEAVE_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') >= #{yy} || '0101') AND (U.ENTER_DT IS NULL OR TO_CHAR(U.ENTER_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') <= #{yy} || '1231')
AND U.USE_YN = 'Y' AND (U.LEAVE_DT IS NULL OR TO_CHAR(U.LEAVE_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD')) AND (U.ENTER_DT IS NULL OR TO_CHAR(U.ENTER_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') <= #{yy} || '1231')
AND (SUBSTR(NVL(U.VIEW_DEPT_ID, U.DEPT_ID), 1, 5) NOT IN ('GUN00', 'GUN95')) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_PM07M02 M WHERE M.YY = #{yy} AND M.USER_ID = U.ID ) ORDER BY NVL(D.SORT_NO, 9999) ASC, D.DEPT_NM ASC, U.NAME ASC
SELECT 'VAC' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') || '-' || LPAD(MOD(TB_PM07M01_SQ01.NEXTVAL, 10000), 4, '0') FROM DUAL

SELECT S.CODE_ID AS WORK_RPT_S, S.CODE_KIND AS WORK_RPT_M, M.CODE_KIND AS WORK_RPT_L FROM TB_CM05M01 S JOIN TB_CM05M01 M ON M.CODE_ID = S.CODE_KIND WHERE S.CODE_ID LIKE '%9901' AND ( S.CODE_ID LIKE SUBSTR(#{deptId}, 1, 5) || '%' OR S.CODE_ID LIKE #{deptId} || '%' OR 1=1 ) AND S.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY (CASE WHEN S.CODE_ID LIKE SUBSTR(#{deptId}, 1, 5) || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END) ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
SELECT TB_PM01M01_SQ01.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_PM01M01 ( FILE_TRGT_KEY, CO_CD, WORK_RPT_NO, WORK_RPT_ID, WORK_RPT_DT, WORK_RPT_L, WORK_RPT_M, WORK_RPT_S, WORK_RPT_HOUR, WORK_RPT_RMK, ISSUE_YN, CREAT_ID, CREAT_PGM, CREAT_DTTM ) VALUES ( #{fileTrgtKey, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{coCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{workRptNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{workRptId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{workRptDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{workRptL, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{workRptM, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{workRptS, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{workRptHour, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{workRptRmk, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NVL(#{issueYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'N'), #{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'PM0701P01', SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT ENTER_DT FROM TB_CM06M01 WHERE ID = #{userId}
SELECT 'DM' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD')||'-'||LPAD(MOD(TB_PM01M01_SQ02.NEXTVAL, 10000), 4, '0') FROM DUAL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_PM07M03 (CO_CD, REQ_NO, VAC_DT, WORK_HOUR, CREAT_ID, CREAT_PGM, CREAT_DTTM) VALUES ( #{coCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{reqNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{vacDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{workHour, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'PM0701P01', SYSDATE )
mapper.delete: /* 휴가/근태 삭제/수정 시 TB_PM01M01 에 자동 등록된 일일작업일지 레코드 제거 */ DELETE FROM TB_PM01M01 WHERE WORK_RPT_ID = (SELECT REQ_ID FROM TB_PM07M01 WHERE REQ_NO = #{reqNo}) AND WORK_RPT_DT IN (SELECT VAC_DT FROM TB_PM07M03 WHERE REQ_NO = #{reqNo}) AND (WORK_RPT_S LIKE '%9901' OR WORK_RPT_S LIKE '%9903')
mapper.select: SELECT CO_CD, REQ_NO, VAC_DT, WORK_HOUR, WORK_RPT_NO FROM TB_PM07M03 WHERE REQ_NO = #{reqNo} ORDER BY VAC_DT ASC

SELECT U.ID AS USER_ID, U.NAME AS USER_NM, SUBSTR(NVL(U.VIEW_DEPT_ID, U.DEPT_ID), 1, 5) AS DEPT_ID, D.DEPT_NM, NVL(D.SORT_NO, 999) AS SORT_NO, U.LEVEL_CD, (SELECT LEVEL_NM FROM TB_CM07M01 WHERE LEVEL_CD = U.LEVEL_CD) AS LEVEL_NM, U.TEAM_MANAGER, TO_CHAR(U.ENTER_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ENTER_DT, NVL(TO_CHAR(U.LEAVE_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), #{yy} || '-01-01') AS BASE_DT, CASE WHEN U.ENTER_DT IS NULL THEN '' WHEN U.ENTER_DT > NVL(U.LEAVE_DT, TRUNC(SYSDATE)) THEN '00년00월00일' ELSE TO_CHAR(TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(NVL(U.LEAVE_DT, TRUNC(SYSDATE)), U.ENTER_DT) / 12), 'FM00') || '년' || TO_CHAR(TRUNC(MOD(MONTHS_BETWEEN(NVL(U.LEAVE_DT, TRUNC(SYSDATE)), U.ENTER_DT), 12)), 'FM00') || '월' || TO_CHAR(TRUNC(NVL(U.LEAVE_DT, TRUNC(SYSDATE))) - ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(U.ENTER_DT), TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(NVL(U.LEAVE_DT, TRUNC(SYSDATE)), U.ENTER_DT))), 'FM00') || '일' END AS WORK_YEARS, NVL(G.GRANT_DAYS, 0) AS GRANT_DAYS, NVL(G.WORK_SUBST_DAYS, 0) AS WORK_SUBST_DAYS, NVL(G.SUMMER_VAC_DAYS, 0) AS SUMMER_VAC_DAYS, 0.0 AS PREV_DAYS, NVL(V.M01, 0) AS M01, NVL(V.M02, 0) AS M02, NVL(V.M03, 0) AS M03, NVL(V.M04, 0) AS M04, NVL(V.M05, 0) AS M05, NVL(V.M06, 0) AS M06, NVL(V.M07, 0) AS M07, NVL(V.M08, 0) AS M08, NVL(V.M09, 0) AS M09, NVL(V.M10, 0) AS M10, NVL(V.M11, 0) AS M11, NVL(V.M12, 0) AS M12, NULL AS M01_DETAIL, NULL AS M02_DETAIL, NULL AS M03_DETAIL, NULL AS M04_DETAIL, NULL AS M05_DETAIL, NULL AS M06_DETAIL, NULL AS M07_DETAIL, NULL AS M08_DETAIL, NULL AS M09_DETAIL, NULL AS M10_DETAIL, NULL AS M11_DETAIL, NULL AS M12_DETAIL, NVL(V.USED_DAYS_SUM, 0) AS USED_DAYS_SUM, (NVL(G.GRANT_DAYS, 0) - NVL(G.WORK_SUBST_DAYS, 0) - NVL(G.SUMMER_VAC_DAYS, 0) - NVL(V.USED_DAYS_SUM, 0)) AS BALANCE_DAYS, TO_CHAR(U.LEAVE_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS LEAVE_DT, U.USE_YN, U.SALES_AREA, CASE WHEN U.SALES_AREA = 'SALESAREA60' THEN '생산직' WHEN U.SALES_AREA = 'SALESAREA00' THEN '임원' ELSE '사무직' END AS JOB_DIV_NM, CASE WHEN U.LEAVE_DT IS NOT NULL THEN TO_CHAR(U.LEAVE_DT, 'FMMM/FMDD') || ' 퇴사' ELSE NVL(G.RMK, '') END AS RMK FROM TB_CM06M01 U LEFT JOIN TB_CM04M01 D ON D.DEPT_ID = SUBSTR(NVL(U.VIEW_DEPT_ID, U.DEPT_ID), 1, 5) LEFT JOIN TB_PM07M02 G ON G.YY = #{yy} AND G.USER_ID = U.ID LEFT JOIN ( /* 사원별 1~12월 연차 사용일수 사전 집계 인라인 뷰 (1인당 1행으로 집계하여 대규모 GROUP BY 및 I/O 병목 완전 제거) */ SELECT M.REQ_ID, SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(D.VAC_DT, 5, 2) = '01' THEN (CASE WHEN M.VAC_TYPE_CD = 'PM07TYPE02' OR NVL(D.WORK_HOUR, '8') = '4' THEN 0.5 ELSE 1 END) ELSE 0 END) AS M01, SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(D.VAC_DT, 5, 2) = '02' THEN (CASE WHEN M.VAC_TYPE_CD = 'PM07TYPE02' OR NVL(D.WORK_HOUR, '8') = '4' THEN 0.5 ELSE 1 END) ELSE 0 END) AS M02, SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(D.VAC_DT, 5, 2) = '03' THEN (CASE WHEN M.VAC_TYPE_CD = 'PM07TYPE02' OR NVL(D.WORK_HOUR, '8') = '4' THEN 0.5 ELSE 1 END) ELSE 0 END) AS M03, SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(D.VAC_DT, 5, 2) = '04' THEN (CASE WHEN M.VAC_TYPE_CD = 'PM07TYPE02' OR NVL(D.WORK_HOUR, '8') = '4' THEN 0.5 ELSE 1 END) ELSE 0 END) AS M04, SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(D.VAC_DT, 5, 2) = '05' THEN (CASE WHEN M.VAC_TYPE_CD = 'PM07TYPE02' OR NVL(D.WORK_HOUR, '8') = '4' THEN 0.5 ELSE 1 END) ELSE 0 END) AS M05, SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(D.VAC_DT, 5, 2) = '06' THEN (CASE WHEN
